import subprocess, os, tempfile

def check_lean(code):
    envf = '/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/.agf_env'
    with open(envf) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('AGF_ELAN_HOME='):
                elan_home = line.strip().split('=', 1)[1]
    lean = os.path.join(elan_home, 'bin/lean')
    with open('/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/.agf_lean_path') as f:
        lp = f.read().strip()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['ELAN_HOME'] = elan_home
    env['LEAN_PATH'] = lp
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.lean', mode='w', delete=False) as tf:
        tf.write(code)
        tf_path = tf.name
    res = subprocess.run([lean, tf_path], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    os.unlink(tf_path)
    return res.stdout, res.stderr, res.returncode

code = '''
import Mathlib
import LeanProject.GraphInvariantsComputable

open SimpleGraph

theorem radius_le_eccentricity {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : V) :
    GraphCalc.radius G ≤ GraphCalc.eccentricity G v := by
  unfold GraphCalc.radius
  have hmem : GraphCalc.eccentricity G v ∈ Finset.image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G) Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.mem_image_of_mem
    exact Finset.mem_univ v
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Finset.min_of_mem hmem
  rw [hb]
  have hle : (Finset.image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G) Finset.univ).min ≤ ↑(GraphCalc.eccentricity G v) :=
    Finset.min_le hmem
  rw [hb] at hle
  exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp hle
'''
out, err, rc = check_lean(code)
print('stdout:\n', out)
print('stderr:\n', err)
print('rc:', rc)
